_comment: The 'Weekend Ahead' intro for the Thursday events email. Edit this file — no code change needed. Each key is the week-start date (the THURSDAY the email covers, YYYY-MM-DD); the Thursday workflow computes that automatically. Add a new dated entry before each weekend's send. If a weekend has no entry, the email uses 'default'.
default: A few of the best things happening around the box canyon this weekend — concerts, markets, and gatherings worth getting out for. Pick one and go.
